Headless and SDK runs
  In the last 7 days 2 sessions started as sdk-cli made 3 requests (measured),
  about $0.60 at API prices (estimated), 30% of Claude Code's use in that time
  (estimated).
  Which sessions are headless comes from the entrypoint Claude Code writes to
  its log. It is observed, not documented.
  Max, Ultra and Team plans include monthly API credits that pay for `claude -p`
  and Agent SDK runs made with an API key from your linked Console organisation,
  so those runs stop using your plan's limits. `trove headless` shows how to set
  that up for those jobs only. Runs that already use an API key are not on your
  plan's limits, so this is an upper bound.
